name: Podcast Production
description: Editorially controlled podcast production with transcript-grounded editing and separate audio layers.

tasks.name: Set episode brief
tasks.objective: Define audience, promise, format, length, angle, guests, must-answer questions, exclusions, legal/editorial sensitivities, and what would make the episode worth publishing.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The episode has a specific editorial promise rather than a topic label.

tasks.name: Research and prepare
tasks.objective: Research claims, chronology, terminology, guest work, counterpoints, and likely factual traps. Prepare an interview map or script with optional branches rather than a rigid questionnaire.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Important factual premises are sourced before recording.

tasks.name: Record source material
tasks.objective: Capture isolated or high-quality tracks, room tone, backup recording, markers, and consent/release notes where needed. Preserve untouched originals.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Original recordings remain immutable and recoverable.

tasks.name: Build transcript-grounded edit
tasks.objective: Transcribe, select the strongest factual and narrative beats, remove repetition, reorder only when meaning remains honest, and build a paper edit before destructive waveform work.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every edit can be traced back to source audio.
Reordering does not manufacture a misleading answer or chronology.

tasks.name: Fact-check final script
tasks.objective: Check material claims, names, dates, quotes, pronunciations, statistics, and contextual framing against primary or authoritative sources. Flag claims that require correction, caveat, or removal.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Published factual claims have source support or explicit attribution.

tasks.name: Mix and master
tasks.objective: Clean dialogue without sterilizing it, repair only audible defects, balance tracks, add music/SFX under editorial control, meet delivery loudness/specification targets, and export master plus stems.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Dialogue remains intelligible and natural across target listening devices.

tasks.name: Package publication
tasks.objective: Create title, description, chapters, credits, source links, transcript, captions where relevant, artwork variants, social excerpts, and archival package without making teaser copy more certain than the episode itself.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Show notes and promotional claims accurately represent the published episode.
